title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Sangli District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd., Maharashtra
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated July 23, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹7 lakh (Rupees Seven Lakh only) on Sangli District Central Co-operative Bank Ltd., Maharashtra (the bank) for contravention of provisions of section 20(1) read with section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 (BR Act).
